# annotated varargs ellipsis

class C { void m(String @A ... xs) {} }

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      MethodDeclaration(
        void,
        Definition,
        FormalParameters(
          SpreadParameter(TypeName, MarkerAnnotation(Identifier), VariableDeclarator(Definition))),
        Block))))

# multiple annotations before a varargs ellipsis

class C { void m(String @A @B(1) ... xs) {} }

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      MethodDeclaration(
        void,
        Definition,
        FormalParameters(
          SpreadParameter(
            TypeName,
            MarkerAnnotation(Identifier),
            Annotation(Identifier, AnnotationArgumentList(IntegerLiteral)),
            VariableDeclarator(Definition))),
        Block))))

# annotated array varargs

class C { void m(final String[] @A ... xs) {} }

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      MethodDeclaration(
        void,
        Definition,
        FormalParameters(
          SpreadParameter(
            Modifiers(final),
            ArrayType(TypeName, Dimension),
            MarkerAnnotation(Identifier),
            VariableDeclarator(Definition))),
        Block))))
